description: A gamma-ray transition from one nuclear state to another.

multiplyPlacedWithIntensity.description: Sometimes gammas are identified as degenerate in a study, and the authors may apportion the intensity ('divided') or not ('undivided').  It may also not be clear from the text ('unknown').

initialLevel.description: The index of the level from which this radiation decays.  Absence indicates an unplaced radiation.  Note that one must either specify both initialLevel and finalLevel, or neither.

transitionIntensity.description: The measured intensity of this gamma ray and its associated conversion electrons.

absoluteIntensity.description: Intensity per 100 decays of the parent in a decay dataset.
